size_signals.signal: Owner Fred Albert plus a crew, as described in reviews; service list spans design, lawn care, hardscape and lighting
Mon-Sat 8am-5pm hours and card acceptance published on a directory listing
4.9 from 34 reviews on HomeAdvisor and 4.8 from 36 on the Birdeye aggregate

scores.reasons: Gap: website is a 404, so findability, answerability and bookability sit near zero. Pay: small owner-crew business; design/install jobs run a few thousand dollars, so a few jobs cover the work. Ease: a portfolio site plus a form is a short, well-understood build. Evidence: the 404 was confirmed directly; the rest rests on third-party profiles and the Google listing could not be opened.
